_comment: Motif definitions for the ALSW/ALSP/EPSPS prime-editing amplicon-seq experiment. All motif sequences and allele logic are validated against the gold-standard motif_count_summary.tsv produced on 2026-06-01/02. Do NOT modify motif sequences without re-validating.

targets.name: ALSP_core
targets.note: Core edit site motif, does not discriminate between chr01 and chr11 alleles. Validated.
targets._alignment_fields: Fields below are used by 07_alignment_edit_classifier.py and 08_prepare_crispresso2_inputs.py. They are NOT used by the validated motif-count pipeline (scripts 01-06).
targets.desired_edit_description: C9T (C to T substitution at position 9 of the WT motif, 0-indexed)
targets._reference_amplicon_note: UNKNOWN: full amplicon reference sequence not provided for this analysis. Alignment-based analysis will use the motif as a short reference. Provide the full amplicon sequence here to enable complete read alignment.
targets.analysis_notes: ALSP core motif. Does not discriminate alleles. Full amplicon reference unavailable.

targets.name: ALSP_chr01
targets.note: Allele-discriminating motif for ALSP chromosome 1 homeolog. Validated.
targets._reference_amplicon_note: UNKNOWN. Provide chr01-specific amplicon sequence to enable alignment.
targets.analysis_notes: chr01 allele. Allele discrimination via flanking SNP (TTGTTGCTATAACT).

targets.name: ALSP_chr11
targets.allele_discriminating_snp: TTGTTGCTATAACCC (chr11-specific flanking sequence, C at the discriminating position)
targets.note: Allele-discriminating motif for ALSP chromosome 11 homeolog. Validated.
targets._reference_amplicon_note: UNKNOWN. Provide chr11-specific amplicon sequence to enable alignment.
targets.analysis_notes: chr11 allele. Allele discrimination via flanking SNP (TTGTTGCTATAACCC).

targets.name: ALSW
targets.note: ALSW single-allele motif pair. DO NOT split ALSW into alleles unless validated. Validated.
targets.desired_edit_description: G8T (G to T substitution at position 8 of the WT motif, 0-indexed)
targets._reference_amplicon_note: UNKNOWN: full ALSW amplicon reference sequence not provided. Alignment-based analysis will use the 24bp WT motif as a short reference. This enables detection of indels within the motif window but not the full amplicon.
targets.analysis_notes: Primary target of this analysis. Single-allele. Full amplicon reference unavailable — alignment uses 24bp motif as reference.

targets.name: EPSPS_full
targets.note: EPSPS full intended PE edit (both C→T changes). No full edits detected in the validated run. Validated.
targets.desired_edit_description: C1T + C12T (two substitutions required for full desired edit)
targets._reference_amplicon_note: UNKNOWN. Provide full EPSPS amplicon sequence to enable alignment.
targets.analysis_notes: Dual-edit target. Full amplicon reference unavailable.

targets.name: EPSPS_partial1_front
targets.note: EPSPS partial edit: front change only (C1T). Low-level signal only. Validated.
targets.desired_edit_description: C1T only (front half of full EPSPS edit)

targets.name: EPSPS_partial2_back
targets.note: EPSPS partial edit: back change only (C12T). Low-level signal only. Validated.
targets.desired_edit_description: C12T only (back half of full EPSPS edit)

allele_aware_targets._comment: allele_aware_targets are used ONLY by 11_allele_aware_precise_edit.py. They do NOT affect the validated motif-count pipeline (scripts 01-06). Backward-compatible addition.
allele_aware_targets._how_it_works: Search for allele_common_anchor in the read. Base immediately after the anchor is the allele-discriminating SNP. Base at snp_offset + edit_offset_from_snp is the edit site.
allele_aware_targets._anchor_derivation: Common prefix of ALSP_chr01 and ALSP_chr11 29bp motifs (positions 0-12). Position 13 is the allele-discriminating SNP.

chr01._reference_note: Full chr01 amplicon sequence not available. SNP-based assignment only.

allele_snps.description: chr01-specific T at position 13 of the 29bp allele motif (TTGTTGCTATAACT...)
allele_snps.source: Derived from ALSP_chr01 vs ALSP_chr11 motif comparison (validated motif-count analysis)

chr11._reference_note: Full chr11 amplicon sequence not available. SNP-based assignment only.

allele_snps.description: chr11-specific C at position 13 of the 29bp allele motif (TTGTTGCTATAACCC...)
allele_snps.source: Derived from ALSP_chr01 vs ALSP_chr11 motif comparison (validated motif-count analysis)

edit.name: C_to_T_ALS_edit
edit._offset_derivation: Edit at position 23 in 29bp motif; SNP at position 13; offset = 23 - 13 = 10
edit.notes: The edit (C→T at pos 23) is 10 bp downstream of the allele-discriminating SNP (pos 13). It must not be used to assign allele identity.

edit_window._note: Conservative window around the edit site (pos 23 ± 3 bp). Positions within this window are excluded from allele assignment scoring as an additional safeguard.

allele_aware_targets.notes: ALSP (N. benthamiana ALS homeologs). Allele assignment uses single SNP at position 13 of the 29bp context motif. SNP coordinates derived from validated ALSP_chr01/chr11 motif comparison. Full amplicon reference sequences not available — SNP-only assignment mode.

Allele-discriminating SNP positions for ALSW chr01/chr11 homeologs are not available for this analysis. Provide allele_common_anchor, allele_snps coordinates, and edit position to enable allele-aware mode for ALSW. Script 11 will skip this target gracefully.
